## What it is

This is my senior research project. I explored the relationship between internalized stereotypes of hard work and innate intelligence and academic help-seeking behavior in Asian American college students. To examine these relationships, I conducted correlation, regression, and mediation analyses.  Results were presented at Willamette University's Student Scholardship Recognition Day (SSRD) in Spring of 2024.

## What I did

- Conducted a literature review on the model minority stereotype (MMS) and help-seeking behavior.
- Added a measure for help-seeking behavior to a survey, and assisted in applying for IRB approval.
- Cleaned and analyzed the data, reporting the results in a research-style paper.
- Results revealed that internalized stereotypes were differently associate with help-seeking behaviors.
